## Description

Takes positions after a repurchase announcement or based on repurchase intensity, using event windows and liquidity filters.

## Where it may fit

Post-announcement periods when buyback news is not immediately fully incorporated and execution can be controlled.

## Vehicles

Equity event-driven, activist and systematic event funds.

## Required data

Timestamped buyback announcements, authorization size, historical execution/repurchases, shares outstanding, prices and filings.

## Caveats

An authorization is not a promise of actual purchases; separate announcement effects from completed repurchase data and control for confounding news.
